description: Finalize a presigned URL media upload. Call after uploading to the upload_url from upload_media, or after PUTting bytes directly to an upload_url minted by get_media_upload_url. Needs only { asset_id, domain } plus the same MCP/API token already on this session — no browser or cookie. Validates the file and processes dimensions/thumbnails — for a PDF that means rasterizing page one into a badged thumbnail. Bytes that are not really a PDF are rejected; a genuine PDF that will not rasterize still finalizes, just without a preview.

domain.description: The same site domain passed to get_media_upload_url.

name: finalize_media_upload
title: Finalize Media Upload
